datasets.name: Aerial photographs of Japanese locations with landslide histories
datasets.verbatim: Due to the physical risks and challenges of accessing these areas, Japan's Geospatial Information Authority creates maps from aerial photos for damage assessment and recovery [4].

methods.name: Ensemble U-Net model
methods.summary: An ensemble learning framework that integrates three U-Net models using a bagging (bootstrap aggregating) technique to predict landslide areas from aerial photographs.
methods.source: Jonpaul Nnamdi Opara, Ryo Moriwaki, and Pang-jo Chun
methods.verbatim: An Ensemble U-Net model integrating three U-Nets has been proposed to predict landslide areas from aerial photographs.

reproducibility_assessment: The landslide inventory is not linked or referenced, and the custom code for the Ensemble U-Net model is not available.
